completion_data.completion_summary: Fixed the dual-path root cause of stale/misplaced orchestrator handoff reads: absolute-path anchors added to skill-base.sh and all hard-mode write instructions, a PostToolUse hook catches misplaced Write/Edit writes, and both orchestrators gate reads on dispatch-window freshness with a mechanism-agnostic stray-handoff sweep.

memory_candidates.content: For a shared PostToolUse hook that must be an error (not advisory), omit the sibling hooks' `2>/dev/null || echo '{}'` suffix in settings-hooks.json — that suffix is what forces exit 0 and swallows stderr; without it, a hook's exit 2 and stderr text reach the model as a real tool error.

A PostToolUse hook matched on Write|Edit reads tool_input.file_path and is structurally blind to any write performed via Bash redirection (e.g. `jq -n ... > "$path"`), because a Bash tool_input carries only the unexpanded command text — the variable name appears literally, never its resolved value. When a script can also write the same artifact via Bash redirect, the hook covers only the agent-direct path; pair it with an absolute-path fix at the script layer plus a reader-side sweep as the mechanism-agnostic backstop.

Resolve a script's repo root from BASH_SOURCE (`cd "$(dirname "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")/../.." && pwd`) rather than the ambient cwd or `git rev-parse --show-toplevel` — it stays correct regardless of caller cwd and inside git worktrees/nested repos where `git rev-parse` answers a different question. Export it once (e.g. SKILL_REPO_ROOT) and build all absolute downstream paths from it.
